note: No voice-over. This is the ON-SCREEN text in reading order; clock.mjs turns it into a word table at reading pace, and every cue in build.mjs is chained to a word in it, exactly as it would be to a VO take. Each | adds 0.3 s of hold after the word it follows. Swap in a real take (tts.mjs) later and build.mjs works unchanged.
